WITH RECURSIVE "__exportlite_batches"("first", "last") AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT CASE WHEN "__exportlite_source"."id" IS NULL THEN json('ExportLite: primary key must not be null') ELSE "__exportlite_source"."id" END FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id" LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT "__exportlite_source"."id" FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id" LIMIT 1 OFFSET 255)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      (SELECT CASE WHEN "__exportlite_source"."id" IS NULL THEN json('ExportLite: primary key must not be null') ELSE "__exportlite_source"."id" END FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source"
        WHERE "__exportlite_source"."id" > "__exportlite_batches"."last" ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id" LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT "__exportlite_source"."id" FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source"
        WHERE "__exportlite_source"."id" > "__exportlite_batches"."last" ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id" LIMIT 1 OFFSET 255)
    FROM "__exportlite_batches"
    WHERE "__exportlite_batches"."last" IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT (
    SELECT CAST(json_group_array(json_object('id', "__exportlite_c0", 'name', "__exportlite_c1", 'note', "__exportlite_c2", 'active', "__exportlite_c3")) AS BLOB)
    FROM (SELECT "__exportlite_source"."id" AS "__exportlite_c0", "__exportlite_source"."name" AS "__exportlite_c1", "__exportlite_source"."note" AS "__exportlite_c2", "__exportlite_source"."active" AS "__exportlite_c3" FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source"
      WHERE "__exportlite_source"."id" BETWEEN "__exportlite_batches"."first" AND coalesce("__exportlite_batches"."last", (SELECT "__exportlite_source"."id" FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id" DESC LIMIT 1))
      ORDER BY "__exportlite_source"."id")
  ), CASE WHEN "__exportlite_batches"."last" IS NOT NULL THEN 256 ELSE
    (SELECT count(*) FROM main."data" AS "__exportlite_source" WHERE "__exportlite_source"."id" >= "__exportlite_batches"."first") END
  FROM "__exportlite_batches"
  WHERE "__exportlite_batches"."first" IS NOT NULL
